title: Configure keeps values that no longer exist
body:
**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

- Pass { insideBoundingBox } to Configure
- Remove it and pass only { aroundLatLng }
- Configure is put into the url twice: 

```
"&configure[insideBoundingBox]=42.0095169,-114.131211,32.528832,-124.482003&configure[aroundLatLng]=33.7489954,-84.3879824"
```

I expect if there's no props on configure, the values will be removed from the search state :) 

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- react-instantsearch

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**

3.1.0

comments.body: @mthuret `this` is available and is "persisted" independently for each instance in `getProvidedProps`. This is used in [infinite-hits](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/v2/packages/react-instantsearch/src/connectors/connectInfiniteHits.js)

Any progress on this? This is breaking a search feature we actually pushed to production. Why is it too hard to simply take the search state from the url on mount? Pretty sure this would fix the other issue I have about the location state not being there on a refresh. Thanks :)

Hi @zackify,

As I mentioned here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1967 it should work to read Configure props from the search state only when mounting a component, it's just that its needs further development and architecture. But be sure we are going to plan this.

In the mean time, can you tell me if reading the search state on your side and pass the right props to the Configure widget can work? I did a little geo search recipe illustrating it here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/v2/packages/react-instantsearch/examples/geo-search

Thanks :)

Thanks, I will try parsing it out of the search state myself which should
work for now! I'll reply when I do that.
This works just fine for now. Thanks

Great that's nice to hear @zackify! 

I close this issue. You can follow this one instead regarding the mounting event for configure https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1955).
